notes: Telegram could end up as two cards in Settings, each holding half the setup: your bot token and paired chat on one, every send quietly using the other, and no amount of renaming or re-saving could make them meet. The two cards now merge into one on their own, keeping your token, your paired chat, and the name you gave your bot. Found on a beta Kit, fixed for every Kit.
If a pairing was mid-handshake when the cards merged, the handshake stays open: your first message still lands as a pairing request instead of being dropped.
